title: Release record
description: The record of what reached users, written by `hitld release make` when the owner makes a release (design part 3.2, Milestones and releases): one file per release, work/releases/<tag>.md, named by its tag. The body holds the notes. In the files backend each interface_delta entry is one line of text, "<impact> <area>: <what>"; this schema covers the entity as the read API returns it.

id.description: The tag: v and the version, such as v0.4.0 or v0.4.0-rc.1.

version.description: A semantic version. A pre-release version carries a hyphen and identifiers, such as 0.4.0-rc.1.

previous.description: The last full release before this one, which the interface delta and the bump are measured from. Absent for the first release. A pre-release is never the base of a bump.

bump.description: From the interface delta alone: major for a breaking change (minor while the version is 0.y.z, with a breaking entry in the delta), minor for an additive change, patch otherwise.

interface_delta.description: The changes to the public interface since previous that justify the bump (design part 16.5).

decision.description: The decision or the precedent under which it was made: a tracker ID, a precedent ID, or owner when the owner made it directly in the main session.

items.description: Items closed since previous, written into the record when it is made so readers need no git.

milestones.description: Milestones whose check had passed on the released code, written into the record when it is made.
